name: auto-pause
description: Pauses Claude Code at a safe point before the usage limit and writes a handoff with a ready-to-paste resume prompt.

warn_at_percent_left.title: Warn at % left
warn_at_percent_left.description: 5-hour limit: warn Claude when this percentage is left (0-100). Keep it above the pause value.

pause_at_percent_left.title: Pause at % left
pause_at_percent_left.description: 5-hour limit: pause and write a handoff when this percentage is left (0-100). 8 means at 92% used.

gate_after_tool_calls.title: Gate after tool calls
gate_after_tool_calls.description: After the pause notice, Claude gets this many tool calls to finish or undo its current step before other tools are blocked (0-1000).

gate_after_points.title: Gate after % used
gate_after_points.description: After the pause notice, block other tools once usage rises by this many percent, even if tool calls remain (1-100).

weekly_warn_at_percent_left.title: Weekly warn at % left
weekly_warn_at_percent_left.description: 7-day limit: warn Claude when this percentage is left (0-100).

weekly_pause_at_percent_left.title: Weekly pause at % left
weekly_pause_at_percent_left.description: 7-day limit: pause and write a handoff when this percentage is left (0-100).

handoff_dir.title: Handoff folder
handoff_dir.description: Folder for handoffs, relative to the project root (letters, digits, . _ - and / only). Kept out of git via .git/info/exclude.

handoff_word_budget.title: Handoff word budget
handoff_word_budget.description: Target handoff length in words (100-10000). A handoff over 1.2 times this is sent back to be shortened.
